name: verify_full_lineage.py
mathematical_scope: Nested phase19 through phase12 archive test runner with a fresh temporary directory for each phase root.
input_and_guard_coverage: ZIP CRC checks and exactly-one-root checks; no cryptographic archive/member identity, total extraction limits, dependency version pins, environment scrub or discovered-test counts.
costs: Up to eight subprocesses with 240s each; capture_output can retain arbitrarily large output and archive expansion is unbounded.
test_evidence: Each child return code is checked and phase list recorded; zero-test discovery still exits successfully. No source was executed.
acceptance_boundary: VERIFIED PHASES means selected subprocesses returned zero, not that historical expected suites/source hashes were verified.
findings: L16–18 archive contents are trusted executable inputs when this script is run. L24 retains ambient environment and prepends one PYTHONPATH root. L25–30 do not enforce nonzero/expected test counts.
